papers.title: Association of Blood Pressure with Mild Cognitive Impairment in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: A Multicenter Cross-Sectional Study
papers.reason: This clinical study uses MoCA to characterize MCI risk in diabetes but does not specifically assess executive-function mechanisms or develop a digital biomarker.

papers.title: Multimodal Neurorehabilitation Including Auditory EEG Neurofeedback: A Proof of Concept Tested After Resection of a Giant Olfactory Groove Meningioma
papers.reason: The paper links executive-function improvement to longitudinal EEG spectral and connectivity changes, although its uncontrolled single-case design substantially limits inference.

papers.title: Effects of 12-week 24-form Tai Chi on cognitive function, cerebral perfusion, and vascular function in postmenopausal women with mild cognitive impairment: an exploratory randomized controlled trial
papers.reason: This exploratory MCI trial reports intervention-related changes in attention, visuospatial/executive performance, and cerebral perfusion that could inform mechanistic models of cognitive impairment.

papers.title: Preoperative ultrasound to identify prefrailty or mild cognitive impairment in patients undergoing total hip/knee replacement: a single-center, prospective, cohort pilot study
papers.reason: The study evaluates muscle ultrasound as an MCI screening marker but finds no predictive utility and does not examine executive function or cognition-specific digital signals.

papers.title: Neuroergonomic Assessment of Virtual Reality Training in Additive Manufacturing Using Wearable EEG
papers.reason: Wearable EEG and subjective measures characterize attention, cognitive control, and workload during human training, but executive function is secondary to evaluating VR instruction.

papers.title: Eyes-Open Fronto-Central Alpha Activity as an Electrophysiological Correlate of Working Memory in Children with Predominantly Inattentive ADHD
papers.reason: This study directly identifies an eyes-open frontocentral alpha correlate of working-memory performance in inattentive ADHD, providing a clinically relevant neural constraint for executive-function models.

papers.title: Causal reinforcement learning for personalized adaptive interventions in mild cognitive impairment
papers.reason: The title indicates a causal reinforcement-learning method for personalizing MCI interventions, but the absent summary provides no evidence that it models executive function or develops a cognitive biomarker.

papers.title: Perceptual Features of Arithmetic Expressions Bias Visual Attention: An Online Eye‐Tracking Study
papers.reason: The eye-tracking experiment directly characterizes attentional allocation during problem solving and relates gaze behavior to individual differences in working memory and inhibition.
